enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +20: Passive: +20 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Frozen Depths Lore +16: Passive: Your Negative, Poison and Cold spells gain a +16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Frozen Depths +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Negative, Cold and Poison Spell Power.
Necromancy Focus +6: +6 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Evocation Focus +6: +6 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Spell Penetration +6: Passive: +6 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Bless Ward: You are warded against the Bless spell.
Bane of the Depths: Your Negative, Poison and Cold spells automatically apply the effects of Bane to enemies struck.
